title: Marguerite and the Portrait
author: Isandro Zhou
blurb: Wren Voss, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. But when the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must finish the ritual the founders started, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
